[PREFERENCE] User is interested in tips on how to store coffee beans to keep them fresh.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for storing coffee beans:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Store in an airtight container.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Keep in a cool, dark place.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Store at room temperature (60-70°F/15-21°C).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Keep away from strong smells.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Use within 7-14 days of opening.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Freeze for longer storage (up to 3-6 months).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Grind just before brewing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Check for freshness regularly.  
[PREFERENCE] User is experimenting with different coffee-to-water ratios for a French press.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] General guideline for coffee-to-water ratio for French press is 1:15 to 1:17 (coffee:water).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided rough guide for different cup sizes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 cup (8 oz): 17-20 grams coffee, 255-340 ml (8.5-11.5 oz) water.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 2 cups (16 oz): 34-40 grams coffee, 510-680 ml (17-23 oz) water.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 3 cups (24 oz): 51-60 grams coffee, 765-1020 ml (25.5-34.5 oz) water.
